description.p: hpsdr-rs is a desktop client for openHPSDR Protocol 1 and Protocol 2 software-defined radios (Metis/Ozy-style and Hermes/Orion-style boards, including the ANAN series and the Hermes Lite 2), using WDSP for DSP. It can also use an RX-888 Mk2, RTL-SDR or MSI.SDR USB receiver.

Features include spectrum/waterfall display, multiple simultaneous receivers, PureSignal PA linearization, diversity reception, a graphic equalizer, transverter support, MIDI control surfaces, a CW decoder, and CAT/rigctl/TCI control servers for use with WSJT-X and similar digital-mode software.
